examples.text_en: The team gave a scrappy but brave performance.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍表现出色，虽显凌乱却很勇敢。

examples.text_en: He would scrawl his name on the paper.
examples.text_zh: 他会在纸上潦草地写下自己的名字。

examples.text_en: Please do not scrawl on this new book.
examples.text_zh: 请不要在这本新书上乱涂。

examples.text_en: He posted a long screed about the new rules.
examples.text_zh: 他就这些新规定发了一篇冗长的文章。

examples.text_en: Her angry screed filled three pages.
examples.text_zh: 她愤怒的长文写满了三页。

examples.text_en: She reads a passage from scripture every morning.
examples.text_zh: 她每天早上都读一段经文。

examples.text_en: The holy scripture was kept in a glass case.
examples.text_zh: 这部圣书被保存在玻璃柜里。

examples.text_en: He unrolled the ancient scroll with care.
examples.text_zh: 他小心地展开了那卷古老的卷轴。

examples.text_en: Please scroll down to see the next page.
examples.text_zh: 请向下滚动查看下一页。

examples.text_en: She had to scrub the floor twice.
examples.text_zh: 她不得不把地板擦洗了两遍。

examples.text_en: He scrubbed the pan until it shone.
examples.text_zh: 他把锅擦得发亮。

examples.text_en: The food was scrumptious and very good.
examples.text_zh: 这食物非常可口。

examples.text_en: That was a scrumptious thing to eat.
examples.text_zh: 那真是一种绝妙的美味。

examples.text_en: He had no scruple about the money.
examples.text_zh: 他对这笔钱毫无顾忌。

examples.text_en: She had a scruple about this kind of work.
examples.text_zh: 她对这种工作有所顾虑。

examples.text_en: He did the work scrupulously and on time.
examples.text_zh: 他一丝不苟地按时完成了工作。

examples.text_en: We check the food scrupulously every morning.
examples.text_zh: 我们每天早上都仔细检查食物。

examples.text_en: His motives were barely scrutable to us.
examples.text_zh: 他的动机让我们几乎无法理解。

examples.text_en: She gave a scrutable account of the events.
examples.text_zh: 她对事件作了清晰的说明。

examples.text_en: The judge began to scrutinize the written report.
examples.text_zh: 法官开始仔细检查那份书面报告。

examples.text_en: She scrutinized every line of the contract.
examples.text_zh: 她仔细审阅了合同的每一行。

examples.text_en: The work was under close scrutiny all day.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作一整天都受到严密检查。

examples.text_en: We need more scrutiny of this new plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要对这个新计划进行更多审查。
